answer: An agent economy can forge identity through live spot checks: during each epoch the protocol sends each agent unpredictable challenges that must be answered within minutes, keyed to its private key and the epoch seed. A farm running a thousand heads cannot answer a thousand simultaneous checks, so each extra fake demands its own live operator — a cost no haven of idle accounts can dodge. Miss a check and the identity freezes, its locked balance forfeiting, so a gale of fakes collapses the moment the checks arrive.
